name: HYPR
fix_description: The initialize function uses reinitializer(2) but was not called during proxy deployment, leaving it callable by anyone. Fix: call initialize immediately in the proxy deployment/upgrade script, or add an explicit onlyOwner/onlyProxyAdmin check to initialize. Alternatively, set the initializer version in the constructor of the implementation to prevent re-initialization.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short two-step exploit: re-initialize the proxy with an attacker-controlled messenger, then call finalizeERC20Withdrawal to drain tokens. The bug is essentially an obvious improper initialization/access-control issue and the PoC is tiny with minimal protocol-specific complexity.
